name: MCPCat
description: Real-time weather, express tracking, DNS and website checks via one MCP endpoint.
description_zh: 一个端点直连实时天气、快递物流查询与网站可用性检测等数据服务，注册获取 API Key 即可连接使用。
description_en: Connect to real-time weather, express tracking, DNS lookup and website availability checks through a single MCP endpoint with your API key.
examples_zh: 帮我查一下北京明天天气怎么样
查一下顺丰单号 SF1234567890 到哪了
帮我检测 example.com 的网站状态和 DNS 解析
examples_en: What's the weather in Beijing tomorrow?
Track my SF Express shipment SF1234567890
Check the HTTP status and DNS of example.com
